description: Full rendered markdown for entity types that have no dedicated tool. Required param: `entity_type` (principles | phases | domains | technology-categories | scopes | persona). Collections return whole (they are small); entity_type 'persona' also needs `slug`. For capabilities use get_capability; for KPIs get_kpis; for maturity levels get_maturity_model.
name: get_entity
title: Get full text of a small framework entity
